title: Geist: Life Drain charge count with Extra Charge, Rapid Recharge and the Cultist buff, before and after Life Drain T3
question: Life Drain has AbilityCharges 0 until T3 (+3). Does Extra Charge add a charge before T3 (0-charge ability), does it make 4 at T3, and does the Cultist Sacrifice buff (same MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_ABILITY_CHARGES +1, ConditionallyApplied) add another?
hypothesis: Before T3: Extra Charge adds nothing (1 cast, no charge counter). At T3: 3 base, 4 with Extra Charge, 5 with Extra Charge + Cultist buff, 6 with Rapid Recharge + Cultist buff. Any other count refutes the model rows in council/work/tri2/geist_paths.txt.

arms.name: D_T3_extra_charge_cultist_buff
arms.souls: T3, Cultist used on a camp first

controls: tier set with abil bits, logged before each arm
procedure: (D,E) consume a camp NPC with Cultist
read charge counter on the Life Drain icon; cast drains back to back and count casts before the cooldown starts

decision.rule: Exact counts: SUPPORTS the model if every arm matches its expected count; any mismatch REFUTES and the Extra Charge timing in geist is recomputed.
